image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a wombat grazing on green grass. The animal has a stocky, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse, grey-brown fur. Its head is broad and blunt, lowered towards the ground, obscuring the eyes but revealing small rounded ears and a large, dark nose. The forelimbs are visible, appearing short and sturdy with claws digging into the turf. The background is a soft-focus field of green grass.

The left front paw merges slightly indistinctly with the grass blades. While it looks like it's digging, the individual toes/claws lack sharp definition and seem to melt into the green texture.
